create_DMCWrapper_env: create a DMCWrapper gym environment from a DM Control domain and task name
run_DMCWrapper_step: run a step on the DMCWrapper environment with a normalized action and get observations
build_DMCWrapper_pixel_obs: build a DMCWrapper environment that returns pixel-based observations instead of state vectors
test_DMCWrapper_reset: test the DMCWrapper reset method to verify it returns valid initial observations
review_DMCWrapper_action_conversion: review the DMCWrapper _convert_action method that maps normalized actions to true action space
